t: What Semiconductor Materials Database Is All About
title: What Semiconductor Materials Database Is All About
description: Semiconductors conduct in between: silicon's 1.12 eV band gap makes it the switchable foundation of computing. Doping adds carriers — phosphorus donates electrons (n-type), boron accepts them (p-type) — and the p-n junction is the diode, transistor, and solar cell in embryo. Gallium nitride's 3.4 eV gap makes blue LEDs and fast chargers; silicon carbide handles EV voltages silicon can't. This database is the complete semiconductor material: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
